meta.name: generate-thesaurus
meta.description: Generate controlled vocabulary thesaurus for content domains. Creates comprehensive thesauri with preferred terms, broader/narrower/related terms.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为内容领域生成受控词表，包含优选词和层级关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为专业内容领域构建标准化的术语体系
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build a standardized terminology system for a professional content domain

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能分析指定文件夹或文件中的内容，自动提取关键术语，并整理成一份结构化词表，包含优选词及其上下位、相关关系，帮助统一术语、提升内容查找效率。
howto.when: 当你让Claude分析某个具体文档目录或文件，并请求生成词表时触发。例如要求“生成安全文档的词表”。

say.text: 请分析 /docs/security 目录，生成安全主题词表。
say.note: Claude会扫描该目录内容，输出词表。

say.text: 为 /guides 文件夹生成关键词和关系表，格式用 YAML。
say.note: Claude按指定格式输出结构化的词表。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can analyze content in a specified directory or file, extract key terms, and produce a structured thesaurus with preferred terms, broader/narrower/related relationships, ensuring consistent terminology and improving content findability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to analyze a specific document path and generate a thesaurus. For example: "Generate a thesaurus for the security docs."

say_en.text: Analyze /docs/security directory and generate a security thesaurus.
say_en.note: Claude scans the directory and outputs the thesaurus.

say_en.text: For the /guides folder, extract keywords and relationships, output as YAML.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a structured thesaurus in the specified format.
